turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No, we cannot buy food-contact items like the 5-litre gaskets (`GSK-SIL-05L` or `GSK-RUB-05L`) from a supplier without a valid food-grade certificate. 

Since these gaskets are used in pressure cookers/cookware meant for food preparation, they fall under strict food safety and compliance regulations. Sourcing uncertified materials, even at a lower price, risks product contamination, regulatory non-compliance, and safety hazards. All suppliers for food-contact components must have a valid food-grade certification on file.
